rounds.q: How many minutes does an average drive-thru trip take, from line to food?
rounds.why: The exact average was 5 minutes 24 seconds. Half of all trips took under 4 minutes 25 seconds.
rounds.src: Intouch Insight, 26th Annual Drive-Thru Study (June-July 2026 visits, 13 US chains)
rounds.fun: 5 minutes 24 seconds from line to food, and half of all trips beat 4 minutes 25!

rounds.q: Out of 100 drive-thru orders, how many come out exactly right?
rounds.why: When the worker was friendly, 91% of orders were right. When not, only 73% were.
rounds.src: Intouch Insight, 26th Annual Drive-Thru Study (June-July 2026 visits, 13 US chains)
rounds.fun: 89 in 100 come out right, and friendly workers got 91% right. Always check the bag!

rounds.q: How many cents was a hamburger in 1948 at the future biggest burger chain?
rounds.why: Two brothers had just rebuilt their burger stand around a speedy new system and a short menu.
rounds.src: McDonald's Corporation, Our History (company history page)
rounds.fun: Fifteen cents for a burger in 1948, from two brothers with a speedy new system!

rounds.q: Per American, how many pounds of potatoes a year go into frozen fries and such?
rounds.why: Fresh potatoes are down to 28 pounds a person, from 46 pounds about twenty years ago.
rounds.src: USDA Economic Research Service, Charts of Note (2022-2024 average)
rounds.fun: 58 pounds of potatoes go to frozen foods like fries, and only 28 are sold fresh!

rounds.q: How many restaurants does the world's biggest burger chain have?
rounds.why: They are spread across more than 100 countries, and about 95% are franchised, not company run.
rounds.fun: 45,356 restaurants in more than 100 countries. That is a lot of burgers!
